entities.summary: Clyde Elmer Anderson was an American politician who served from September 27, 1951 to January 5, 1955, as the 28th governor of Minnesota. Anderson also served from 1939 to 1943 as the 30th lieutenant governor of Minnesota and from 1945 to 1951 as the 33rd.
